limitations: No independently verified source located in this search establishes all three elements together: user next-item behavior, hyperbolic geometry, and generative semantic IDs.
ACM PDF endpoints for the two ACM sources returned HTTP 403; their classifications are ABSTRACT/metadata-level only, not full-text-verified.
The only FULL_TEXT label is limited to an HTTP-200 arXiv PDF endpoint; it supports the hyperbolic sequential-recommendation overlap, not the complete three-way claim.
Search discovery used OpenAlex metadata and public PDF endpoint checks; absence claims are bounded to retrieved records and are not proof that no such work exists.
Do not treat “semantic” representations or hyperbolic sequential recommenders as evidence of generative semantic-ID decoding unless the paper explicitly describes that mechanism.
